test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

The school shall reopened / after summer / vacations of / one month.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the first part of the given sentence, the use of "shall" with "reopened" is **incorrect.**
 
• The correct form should be "shall reopen"
 
• **"Shall" is used with the base form of the verb, which is "reopen" in this case.**

Hence, the correct statement is **"*The school shall reopen __after summer vacations of one month."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When using modal verbs like** "shall," "will," "can," "may,"** etc., the main verb should be in its base form.
 
• Examples:
 
 
• *She **shall go** to the market.*
 
• *They **can see** the movie tonight.*
